chapter.verse: Ute naute ki-itna kip ta hen.
Zinte do nading na mangngilh kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi kimkhat in zin a do laitakun vantungmite ahih lam thei loin zin a do kha uh hi.
Khau khihna a thuak mi tawh kikhih khawm bangin kingaihsun un: pumpi tawh kipelh lo na hih uh ciangin bawlsiatna a thuakte na ngaihsun un.

Mi khempeuh lakah kiteen’na kithupisim ta hen. Pasalte leh zite in khat leh khat a thuman ciat ding uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, numei tawh a mawhte leh mi’ zi tungah a mawhte Pasian in thu a khen ding hi.

Sumduh luatna tawh na kipelh un. Na neihsa zah uh sum tawh lungkim un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Keimah in nang kong paisan ngei kei ding hi, zong kong nusia ngei kei ding hi,” ci-in Pasian in hong gen zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin: “Topa in kei hong huhpa hi a, ka lau kei ding hi. Mite in kei tungah bang hong cih thei ding ahi uh hiam?” ci-in kimuan’na lungsim tawh i gen thei hi.
Pasian’ thu note kiangah hong hilh uh a, note hong uk ngei mite na ngaihsun un. Amaute in bangci gamtatin a si uh teltakin lungngai un la, amau upna lim na zui un.
Zeisu Khazih in zanni, tuni, atawntungin kikheel loin a om hi.
A tuam dangdang, a lamdangdang thuhilhna thak zui kei un. An nek hang hi lo, thupha hehpihna hangin lungkhauh a, na om uh leh, a pha hi. An nekna bek a ngaihsun mite in na manpha a ngah zo kei uh hi.
Buk sungah biakna nasem mite in a nek theih ding ahi lo, biakna tau eite in i nei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, siampi ukpa in mawh maisakna ding biakna gan si, a siangtho mun sungah a tumpih khit ciangin, biakna gan pumpi giahbuk pua lamah mei in a hal hi.
Tua mah bangin Zeisu in ama sisan tawh mite a siangthosak nadingin khuapi kongkhak pua lamah sihna a thuak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in Topa tawh kosiatna thuakin giahbuk pualam ama kiangah nai ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in hih lai takah a kip ding khuapi i nei kei hi: tunung ciangin a hong piang ding khuapi i zong hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua Topa hangin eite in ama min i man’ muk’ gah ahi, phatna biakna Pasian kiangah a tawntungin pia ni.
Thupha bawlna, sum hawmnate na mangngilh kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in hih bang biaknate ah a lungdam hi.

No hong uk mite’ thu ngai un la, amau hong gen bangin gamta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in thusitna a thuakkik ding mite bangin note kha uh noptuam nadingin a kem uh hi. Note noptuamna uh a pian’sak theih nadingin dahna tawh hi loin, lungdam nadingin amaute in sittelna a thuak zawh nadingun kikemin om un.
Kote ading thu hong ngetsak un. Bang hang na cih uh leh, kote in komau pumpi theihna lungsim a pha nei-in, na khempeuh ah a hoihin gamtat nadingin a deih mi ka hi uh hi ci-in ka lungkim uh hi.
Keimah in note kiangah a manlang zaw-a kong paikik theih nadingin, kote ading thu hong ngetsak un ci-in kong hansuah hi.
A tawntung kiciamna sisan hangin Tuucing lianpa ahi, i Topa Zeisu sihna pan a thokiksak nopna Pasian in,
ama deihna thu Zeisu Khazih hangin eite sungah hong bawlna, note in a deihna na zuih nadingun ahoih na khempeuh ah hong kicingsak ta hen. Tua Topa in a tawntungin minthan’na ngah ta hen. Amen.
Ute naute aw, keimah in a tomin gelhin hong zasak ka hih ciangin hansuahna kam na thuak siam un ci-in keimah in note kong thuum hi.
I sanggampa Timoti a kikhah khitna thu na thei un. Amah in a sawt loin hong tung leh, keimah in amah tawh hong paikhawmin note kong mu ding uh hi.
Note hong uk mite khempeuh leh misiangthote khempeuh na hopih un. Itali mite in note hong hopih uh hi.
Note khempeuh tungah hehpihna thupha om ta hen. Amen.
